newsitem.title: INDIA: India allocates wheat, rice for March sale.
newsitem.headline: India allocates wheat, rice for March sale.

text.p: India's Food Ministry has allocated 1.28 million tonnes of rice and 990,000 tonnes of wheat for sale at subsidised prices through public shops in March, a ministry statement said on Thursday.
The statement said the wheat allocation had been increased by 19,000 tonnes compared with the February quota while the rice allocation has been cut by 1,000 tonnes.

"This has been done in view of the increased demand from the states even though the offtake of wheat in November and December last year (1996) was 691,000 tonnes and 801,000 tonnes," the statement said.
